notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two cards in hand.
You control no Snakes.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Venser's Journal and Ophiomancer trigger.
Resolve the Venser's Journal trigger, causing you to gain at least two life.
Resolve the Ophiomancer trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
Activate Razaketh by paying 2 life and sacrificing the Snake token, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuflle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.
